# NEW 2026-11-23 v16.5 Module 16.5-A: Steam Age, Early Industrial Revolution, Tier-9 Steam Railway & Nova Elysia Act III (oe_stm_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v165_steam_industry.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly kernel hook (invoked once per calendar year from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch).
# Self-deduplicates via global_var:oe_stm_ran_y ?= current_year, short-circuits cleanly before 1600,
# runs Nova Elysia Act III (1600-1836) only when settled Nova Elysia is active, and runs Global Steam
# & Early Industrial Revolution events (1740-1836) for eligible industrial hosts (max 1 event/year).
oe_stm_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1600
			NOT = { global_var:oe_stm_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_stm_ran_y value = current_year }
		# 1. Nova Elysia Act III Finale (1600-1836) — strictly isolated behind oe_ely_settled = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
				global_var:oe_ely_settled ?= 1
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_stm_eligible_elysia_act3_host = yes
				}
				oe_stm_elysia_act3_tick = yes
			}
		}
		# 2. Global Steam & Early Industrial Revolution (1740-1836)
		if = {
			limit = { current_year >= 1740 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_stm_eligible_industrial_host = yes
				}
				oe_stm_industrial_tick = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
